name: villalbilla-cf
description: App de entrenadores de Villalbilla C.F.

scripts.deploy:cloudflare: pnpm exec expo export --platform web && pnpm exec wrangler deploy
scripts.dev:cloudflare: pnpm exec expo export --platform web && pnpm exec wrangler dev
scripts.test: node --test features.test.cjs free-notifications.test.mjs club-summary.test.cjs internet-updates.test.cjs android-config.test.cjs match-refresh.test.cjs && node logic.test.mjs
scripts.export:android-update: node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local scripts/check-update-config.cjs && expo export --platform android --output-dir work/ota-export
scripts.publish:android-update: pnpm run export:android-update && pnpm dlx eas-cli@25.3.0 update --channel production --platform android --environment production --input-dir work/ota-export --skip-bundler --non-interactive
scripts.prebuild:android: pnpm run check:android-config && expo prebuild --platform android --no-install
